title: ACHIRI — Create scripts/achiri/notify-waitlist.sh (unlock /achiri-launch Step 3)
description: cmdAchiriLaunch() Step 3 checks for scripts/achiri/notify-waitlist.sh or broadcast-waitlist.ts and shows ⚠️ 'not found — use /broadcast' if missing. Create notify-waitlist.sh that: reads workspace/achiri/waitlist.jsonl, extracts chat_ids, sends a Telegram message to each waitlisted user via ACHIRI_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN. Supports --dry-run and --message args. Unlocks ✅ for Step 3.
